keyPoints.descZh: 回答 Yes（她们现在仍在通信）

q1.rubricZh: 要点：Yes, they do（用 do 回答，肯定）。
q1.explanationZh: 最后几段说她们一直互相写信，已经寄了 700 封。问句是反意疑问句，肯定回答用 Yes, they do。

evidence.quote: And, of course, they continued to write to each other.

q2.sampleAnswer: Because Bruce wanted to be penfriends with a girl named Susan, not Clements.

keyPoints.descZh: Bruce 本来想和 Susan 做笔友，不是 Clements
examples: Bruce wanted to be penfriends with Susan, not Clements

q2.rubricZh: 要点：Bruce 本来要写信给 Susan，结果回信的是 Clements。
q2.explanationZh: 第二段说 Bruce 写信给一个叫 Susan 的女孩，回信的却是 Clements，所以她们本来“不该”成为笔友，是个美好的意外。

evidence.quote: Bruce wrote to a girl named Susan.

q3.sampleAnswer: Because it was expensive to make phone calls at that time.

keyPoints.descZh: 当时打国际电话很贵，几分钟就要 35 美元
examples: it was expensive to make phone calls

q3.explanationZh: 第四段说他们盯着时钟，因为几分钟就要花 35 美元，打电话很贵。

evidence.quote: They watched the clock during their first phone call, because a few minutes would cost $35.

q4.sampleAnswer: I think one secret to lasting friendships is honesty. We should never lie to our friends. If the trust between two friends is gone, the friendship will soon follow.(Answers may vary.)

keyPoints.descZh: 说出一个合理的友谊秘诀

examples: If the trust between two friends is gone, the friendship will soon follow.

q4.rubricZh: 开放题：观点合理（如诚实、信任、理解等）并给出理由即可。
q4.explanationZh: 这是开放题。先说出你认为的友谊秘诀（比如诚实、信任、互相理解），再用一两句话解释为什么。
